dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent, irregular semi-closed loops exhibiting jagged, high-intensity light perimeters against a dark gray background. The largest central structure shows a sharp gradient transition from a bright white serrated edge to a darker interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, solid white pixel clusters. Concentration is highest along the mid-lateral region and around the anterior neck area, appearing as isolated, non-gradient points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form a large scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented horizontally along the dorsal-lateral midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Dendritic, branching light-colored patterns extending from the dorsal neck region toward the head, and distinct high-contrast vertical striations visible on the digits of the pectoral flipper.
